commit.message:
🪲fix(harnesses): open Rust and Go clients before benchmarking datatypes (#11)

## Summary

Open Rust and Go clients during benchmark setup, before constructing a
datatype. The central Rust Counter warmup previously stopped with
`ClientNotOpen` on SDKs requiring explicit registration. Both harnesses
also support historical SDK revisions that open during construction, so
candidate comparisons can still run their base leg.

## Validation

Ran the Counter IncreaseBy smoke scenario locally in Rust and Go (50,001
operations each). The Go harness tests passed with both the
explicit-open binding and the previous Go revision.

[Central benchmark
failure](https://github.com/qortoo/qortoo-bench/actions/runs/45488153469)
